notes: Model-specific silero-vad calibration record (ADR 0029). Classification thresholds are the silero v6 published defaults at 16 kHz (0.5 probability threshold; 250 ms minimum speech; 100 ms minimum silence; 30 ms speech pad -> 4000/1600/480 samples). Partition-risk durations (uncovered_speech_duration, long_silence_duration) match the audio-analysis VAD contract. qualification_scope is 'first_device_baseline': these thresholds gate formal speech_likely/non_speech classification (uncalibrated audio stays indeterminate per ADR 0029) but the Chinese/English quality of the selection is only confirmed by the maintainer sample review in the Phase 11 prototype ticket, not by this record.
